e240: pin ↔ axle-hole is not a compatible pair
notes: The booklet builds separate things on purpose, so the graph has four disconnected groups: (1) the Racer X car (bag 1, b1-b72) with its driver; (2) the truck cab, trailer and the seated desk figure (bags 2 and 3, b73-b225 plus b226-b228), joined by the fifth-wheel kingpin edge (b214 to b101); (3) Figure B (b229-b231) and (4) Figure C (b232-b234), which stand free beside the vehicles in the final picture and are not fastened to anything. The car is not fastened to the truck in the manual either.

This is NOT a complete piece-by-piece graph. Many steps are small pictures, so parts and joins were inferred from the step pictures and the inventory pages. Which stud of which part is used is a best guess; the part types and the overall structure are the reliable part.

Port convention after validation: the catalogue gives most plates, bricks, rails and axles only one stud, anti-stud, pin-hole or axle port, but they carry several children. The first join keeps the real port; further joins on the same part leave that port null (a null port means 'somewhere on this part'). Where a part has extra distinct ports (stud.2-4, anti-stud.2, top.2) those were used.

Black minifig legs (inventory label '9339') are now typed lego-970c00, the real design number for minifig legs; the hip join on those legs uses null ports because the catalogue gives no port kind for them. Figure A (blue legs) uses a stud-type hip (torso hip is an anti-stud).

The kingpin coupling between trailer pin b214 and the truck's fifth-wheel liftarm b101 is a revolute join with null ports, because the trailer rests and pivots on the truck in the final picture (page 48).

Wheel and headlight repeats attach to the axle or wedge plate with a null port, and the 'attach' overrides name just the part id (b93 to b94 or b95, b90 to b91). Rim 'tire' port is an axle and tire 'rim' port is an axle-hole; the hex tube ports are pin-holes so tan pins fit. The support rod joins the connector's second axle-hole; the red extender is not joined to the rod.

Parts in the inventory but not placed (not identifiable in the step pictures): 4141580 x2 (mirror arms), one 4107081, 4518406 x3, 4523571 x4 (hub caps), 614126 x4, 3005741 x2, 4100381 x2, spare 4211094 x5, one 4210963, extra 300421 x4, several yellow bricks, plates and curved slopes, extra red plates 366621/371021, extra 302326/362326/302026, the Racer X engine pipes and truck roof details.

Stickers (numbered 1-14 in the steps) are not modelled as parts. Element ids were read from small inventory pictures and may be misread in places. Catalogue entry lego-300124 is named 'Brick 2x2' but was used for the yellow 2x4 brick. lego-366621 was used for red 1x6 plates (stud is 'top.1', anti-stud is 'bottom').
